messages.text: The proposal is for R$49.00, the amount recorded as paid for the wooden watch box. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card. After you confirm, a staff member will review it.
The customer confirmed request prop-9376848bcf524ea2 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
The R$49.00 refund has been recorded. Your receipt number is **R-00000001**.
Why is the refund R$49.00 instead of R$69.00?

The order records R$49.00 as the amount paid for the wooden watch box, so that is the amount refunded. Refunds are based on what was paid for the item, after any discount—not the item’s listed price (refund-policy/v2/amount).
